architecture.enhancement: During both Q refinement rounds, global half-heads read the literal request; relation-local heads read their own physical words. Final input-value read keeps the original full memory.
architecture.routing: Cr retains native physical-word calibration. Frozen native text addressing composed with native-key affinity gives semantic support over C. Multiply the direct physical addressing by this soft support, preserving original total C/reference prior mass.
architecture.execution: Independent trainable physical Q/K/V/O; a single direct execution-C value read plus video-state interaction. No serial value pooling, new semantic write branch, new amplitude gate or hard semantic mask.
architecture.preserved: Native text Q/K/V/O and forward stay frozen; no forced C diversity, no temporal-MSE loss, no new API/model downloads.
architecture.caveat: Native-key semantic affinity is a concrete hypothesis, not proof of semantic correctness or improved scores. Actual noise/video state, input reasoning errors and decoder artifacts remain possible failure modes.
